fields.name: Mira Solheim
fields.bio: Mira is Barkpark's head of product. She turns the messy reality of how teams actually model content into the schema-v2 field types, the Studio editing surface, and the LiveView panels editors live in all day. Mira cares about the editorial experience above all: reference fields that resolve into a visible content graph, search that finds the right document on the first keystroke, and a publish flow that never loses a draft. She writes about product decisions, content modeling for real teams, and what it takes to make a headless CMS feel effortless.
